sources.name: CBN Consumer Protection Regulations (with Annexure D complaint timelines)
NIBSS: User Guide for IDRS (Industry Dispute Resolution Solution)
CBN Circular FPR/DIR/GEN/CIR/01/045: Time Bar for Resolution of Customers' Complaints

entries.subject: complaint_time_bar
entries.display: Consumer complaints are barred six years after the date of the transaction
entries.quote: hereby introduces a time limit of six (6) years for the resolution of consumer complaints effective from the date of transaction

entries.subject: complaint_time_bar_exclusion
entries.display: The six-year time bar does not apply to fraud cases
entries.quote: The time limitation will however not apply to the following: 1. Fraud cases;
entries.notes: Also excluded: complaints already lodged with the institution and the CBN, and international electronic payments whose records are not retained beyond 180 days on Arbiter.

entries.subject: complaint_acknowledgement
entries.display: Institutions must acknowledge a complaint within 24 hours of lodgment
entries.notes: CBN Consumer Protection Regulations s.6.2.2. The captured PDF prints no issue date; effective_from is the publication date of this copy as hosted by the source bank (path /2020/02/).

entries.subject: atm_dispense_error_resolution
entries.display: ATM cash dispense error claim at the customer's own bank: 3 working days for first review
entries.quote: ATM Cash Dispense Error claim - OWN BANK J005 3 2
entries.notes: Annexure D, CCMS code J005; 3 working days first review, 2 working days second review.

entries.subject: fraudulent_withdrawal_resolution
entries.display: Fraudulent withdrawals: 14 working days for first review
entries.notes: Annexure D, code D003; second review 7 working days.

entries.subject: internet_banking_fraud_resolution
entries.display: Internet banking fraud: 3 working days for first review

entries.subject: chargeback_resolution
entries.display: Local chargeback not on us: 5 working days for first review
entries.quote: Chargebacks / Claim local (not on us) B006 5 3
entries.notes: Annexure D, code B006; international chargebacks run to 60 working days.

entries.subject: wrong_account_credit_resolution
entries.display: Wrong account credit: 1 working day for first review

entries.subject: excess_charges_resolution
entries.display: Excess fees and charges: 30 working days for first review

entries.subject: second_level_review_window
entries.display: A dissatisfied complainant has 30 days from the Summary Resolution Communication to request a second-level review
entries.quote: the complainant shall, within 30 days f rom the date of the receipt of the SRC, request in writing for a 2nd level review

entries.subject: idrs_arbitration
entries.value_text: arbitration to NIBSS after the acquirer declines a second time
entries.display: On IDRS, if the acquirer declines a dispute a second time, the issuer can raise arbitration to NIBSS
entries.quote: where Issuer and Acquirer fail to agree (ie if the acquirer declines a 2nd time), an arbitration can be raised to NIBSS to review the transactions and decide which way the reconciliation goes
entries.notes: NIBSS IDRS user guide, last modified 6 March 2025.

notes: Complaint timelines come from Annexure D of the Consumer Protection Regulations, which lists first and second review in working days. The captured Regulations PDF prints no issue date, so entries sourced to it use the publication date of the captured copy (2020-02-01).
